title: Frigid, a Snowy Zombie variant
description: adds a snowy Zombie variant to snowy parts of the world.
body: adds a Snowy Zombie variant to the snowy parts of the world, Called the Frigid, the more hits it does, the longer the frostbite effect lasts, if a Zombie falls in powdered snow it turns into one, and it drops lapis instead of iron.  tested on neoforge 21.1.215 and 21.4.78-beta.
